domestic_evidence: Domestic supply is evidenced indirectly and only in part: (1) the same customs dataset shows JSW Steel as an Indian importer/buyer of raw-material and spares consignments cleared at Indian ports — e.g. "2026-02-27 | HANDAN LANTECH TRADE CO.,LTD | JSW STEEL LIMITED | SPARES FOR RAW MATERIAL HANDLING SYSTEM (RMHS) ... | Tianjin, CHINA | CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India | 84799090 | 7782773" and "2026-02-27 | PERIC HYDROGEN TECHNOLOGIES CO.,LTD. | JSW STEEL LIMITED | SUPPLY OF CATALYST DE OXIDIZING SOLID | Tianjin, CHINA | CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India | 38151100 | 7782757" — i.e. operating plants inside India, not proof of domestic sales. (2) Company site https://www.jsw.in/investors/jsw-steel states "35.7 MTPA capacity" and lists domestic project supplies: "Samruddhi Mahamarg: Steel for Seamless Connectivity", "Atal Setu Bridge", "Mumbai Metro" — these are company statements, not contract records. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report domestic/export revenue split: NOT retrieved (jsw.in annual-report and financial-results pages returned HTTP 404; volza/eximpedia returned HTTP 403; web_search tool was down — searx connection refused). No GSTIN or revenue figure is asserted here.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records with destination, HS and BOL number (Italy, HS 72283029, BOL 1075849, 2026-02-27), plus 413 named trading partners and 59,513 records — this is a real, large-scale exporter, not a claim. Declared HS 732591 (cast-iron grinding balls/grinding media) does not match the observed export HS 72283029 (hot-rolled non-alloy steel round bars); per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection — the company stays in the base and the actual HS should be corrected to the observed 72283029 (or the full observed range), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Note the slug 'jsw-steel-ltd' on ImportKey resolves to a different, small entity (59 records, Ravenna/Italy consignee address) — do not merge it with the main JSW Steel Limited record. Domestic supply: plants and domestic project references exist, but GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP contracts and annual-report revenue split were not publicly retrievable in this session, so those specific fields are null rather than estimated. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not published on the pages read).
